summary: an HTTP handler that serves only the signed-in user's own profile photo
use_when: serve the current user's own picture; no request can name another user
answer 404 for no photo, 502 for a failed fetch
not_for: serving any user's picture by id or handle: this unit refuses to take one from the request
fetching, resizing or caching the photo itself: the injected source does that
authenticating the caller: the injected Caller reads an identity another layer established
